name: bb-plugin-pane-attention
description: Marks an unfocused split pane whose thread finished a turn, or is waiting on you, colours thread families across split panes, and slides folded panes like Xbox 360 blades.

bb.name: Pane Attention
bb.description: Marks unfocused split panes whose thread finished a turn, or is waiting on you, gives a parent and its children's panes a shared colour with a "↳ parent" button on each child, and plays the blade slide between folded panes. A theme draws the colours.
